dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The upper posterior dorsal region displays at least four prominent 'O' shaped structures characterized by a sharp, high-contrast transition from dark exterior pixels to high-intensity light rings, with a secondary gradient shift back to darker interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of solid high-intensity light pixel clusters is concentrated in the anterior dorsal-lateral region, lacking internal gradients. Lower density, isolated blobs are scattered along the lower lateral margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the upper right quadrant form an irregular quadrilateral. Connecting these centroids to the centroid of the anterior high-intensity blob cluster creates a series of elongated, acute triangles across the mid-dorsal plane.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, interconnected reticulated network of light-intensity pixel lines bridges the primary macro-annuli, creating a honeycomb-like topological structure across the posterior dorsal surface.
